title: Investments
subtitle: Your positions and the products you can invest in. Results are added only after they are realised.

open.title: No open positions
open.text: Choose a product to start. Read what generates its return and its risks first.

matured.title: No matured positions
matured.text: Positions appear here when their term has ended and they have been released.

closed_early.title: No positions closed early
closed_early.text: Positions you close before maturity appear here.

howResultsText: When a period ends, the realised result is recorded with evidence and approved by a second staff member. Only then is it posted to positions that were open during the period. Losses are posted the same way.
noProductsText: New products appear here once they are approved. Your existing positions are not affected.

product.howItEarns: How it earns and what can go wrong
product.noResults: No results have been posted yet.
product.pastNotFuture: Past results do not predict future results.

calc.title: Try the numbers · {{name}}
calc.rateHint: Type any result, including a negative one. Nothing is filled in for you.
calc.enterAmount: Enter an amount to see the figures.
calc.valueAtMaturity: Value at the end of the term
calc.disclaimer: This is arithmetic on the numbers you entered, using the product's fee rules. It is not a forecast or a promise of any return.

open.title: Invest in {{name}}
open.riskText: The result can be negative and you can lose money. Results are posted only after they are realised.
open.acceptRisk: I have read the product terms and risks and understand that returns are not guaranteed.
open.mustAccept: Confirm that you have read the terms and risks.

position.awaitingSettlement: The term has ended. The position is released when the result for its last period is posted.

close.title: Close this position early?
close.text: The current value is returned to your available balance minus the early-exit fee of {{rate}}. Results not yet posted are not included.
close.done: Position {{reference}} closed. The amount is in your available balance.

detail.title: Position details
detail.note: Each line is backed by ledger entries. Open Transactions to see them.
